serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a server executable or JavaScript entry. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

notifyWhenMissing.title: Notify When Missing
notifyWhenMissing.description: Show a notification when the language server cannot be found.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the SOFiSTiK server the editor uses.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report static findings and manually imported calculation diagnostics.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer CADINP records, parameters and values for the project's release.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show declaration previews, parameter positions and complete enum lists.

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: Show the parameter slots of the current CADINP record.

definition.title: Definition
definition.description: Navigate to local declarations and project includes.

references.title: References
references.description: Find references to CADINP declarations in the project.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document and project symbols to navigation features.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Color schema-recognized enum values over the grammar's highlighting.

textCase.title: Completion Case
textCase.description: Letter case of CADINP vocabulary inserted by completion.

encoding.title: Project Encoding
encoding.description: Encoding used to read closed project source files. Calculation logs always use UTF-8.
